title: One line of .keel/local/ledger.jsonl
description: Token use of one finished agent, written by the SubagentStop hook from the agent's transcript (last usage row per message id). Input and cache counts are exact; output can be an estimate, see output_estimated.

ts.description: ISO 8601 UTC time the agent stopped.

model.description: message.model of the transcript rows; null if unreadable.

effort.description: effort.level from the SubagentStop input; null when the model takes no effort.

cache_creation_1h_input_tokens.description: Part of cache_creation_input_tokens written with the 1-hour TTL (priced higher).

transcript.description: Path of the agent's transcript. The report sums it again, because at SubagentStop time the transcript can still miss the agent's last response.

output_estimated.description: true when the transcript under-recorded output and output_tokens is an estimate from the visible output (about 4 characters per token, hidden reasoning not included).

requests.description: Number of API requests the agent made.

task.description: Optional label of the keel step, e.g. 'verify:standard'.
